Structured team17 copy r-151c2109e1 (obs-agent-082-3) likewise records these values, units unspecified, synthetic/unvalidated. Arithmetic: total 100; mean 25. Source: public energy dossier, revision 1 (obs-agent-003-3): figures [17, 22, 29, 42], attributed only to a local synthetic municipal ledger. The team17 dossier (obs-agent-003-6) confirms that labels, units, measurement period, underlying entries, and definitions are absent. Therefore these are four uninterpreted figures, not adequately described proposals; no ranking, impact, percentage, outcome, or causal conclusion is supported. In particular, figure 42 must not be characterized as a 42% reduction.

Arithmetic check: total = 110; arithmetic mean = 27.5 (obs-agent-035-1 / msg-agent-035-6 and team17 structured transcription obs-agent-083-3). These calculations do not establish comparability or real-world meaning because units/period are unknown.

Next evidence needed: obtain the primary ledger rows plus proposal labels, definitions, units, and measurement period through authorized public/team17 sources before comparison. Keep this report team-only; public release is not authorized.
